title: refactor(ui)!: fold the providers upload context into fields and data-objectstack, retire @object-ui/providers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXx8nkFj47cDx3oQ4JtqdJS)_

Part of #25921 (the providers/upload fold only; the card's barrel batches and `clearSharedDiscoveryCache` stay on it).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #30559

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：文件、图片、头像字段的上传上下文 `UploadProvider` / `useUpload` 搬进 `@object-ui/fields`，连 ObjectStack 存储服务的上传适配器搬进 `@object-ui/data-objectstack`，两边共用的上传契约类型放进 `@object-ui/types`，`@object-ui/providers` 整包退役。
- 为什么改：这个包只剩上传一件事，少一个要单独发布和维护的包；访问服务器的取数逻辑回到 data 包里，字段包不再依赖一个只为它存在的包。
- 风险与回滚：上传行为不变，预签名请求逐字节相同，控制台和附件面板照常上传；外部宿主若仍从 `@object-ui/providers` 导入，升级时编译报错，changeset 写了改从哪里导入。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/UploadProvider.tsx`（上下文与无 provider 时的本地回退），`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/upload-adapter.ts`（三步上传，与原包代码相同），`.changeset/25921-providers-upload-fold.md`（BREAKING 说明与迁移行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/src/objectstack-upload-scope-12055.test.ts apps/console/src/__tests__/App.uploadAltitude-10131.test.tsx`，预期两个文件全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。PR 自身的改动行数（additions+deletions，GitHub 把两处搬移认作改名）是 2482 行，不到 3000 行。

## What changes

`@object-ui/providers` had one job left: the upload context the file, image and avatar widgets of `@object-ui/fields` upload through, plus the adapters that fill it. This PR moves each piece to the package that owns it and retires the package.

- **`@object-ui/types`** gains `ui/packages/types/src/upload.ts`: the `UploadAdapter`, `UploadOptions` and `UploadResult` interfaces, unchanged in shape. They live here, as `DataSource` does, because `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/data-objectstack` do not depend on each other and both need them.
- **`@object-ui/fields`** gains `src/widgets/UploadProvider.tsx` (`UploadProvider`, `useUpload`, `UploadProviderProps`) and re-exports the three contract types from its entry. `AvatarField`, `FileField` and `ImageField` read it relatively. `createObjectUrlAdapter` moves in as a module-private function: it is still the `blob:` fallback `useUpload` answers with when no provider is mounted, and it is no longer exported.
- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`** gains `src/upload-adapter.ts` (`createObjectStackUploadAdapter`, `ObjectStackUploadAdapterOptions`): fetch logic against an ObjectStack server, so it sits beside the other fetch logic (ui/AGENTS.md section 3). The three-step presign, PUT and complete flow is the original code. Its `scope` option stays typed as `API.UploadScope`, and the objectui#12055 test moved with it.
- **Retired with no replacement:** `createS3Adapter`, `createAzureBlobAdapter`, `S3AdapterOptions`, `AzureBlobAdapterOptions`. They had zero consumers in the workspace and zero in `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` (shallow clone at `6961ab1`; every upload name 0 hits, while a control name hits). A host that uploads to its own bucket writes an `UploadAdapter` against `@object-ui/types`.
- **Importers re-pointed:** the console `App.tsx` (import only; the `UploadProvider` wrap is unchanged), `ProfilePage.tsx`, app-shell's `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`, `SettingsPage.tsx` and one renderer comment, and every test that imported or mocked the package. The `@object-ui/providers` dependency leaves the console, app-shell and fields manifests, its alias lines leave `ui/vitest.config.mts` and four vite configs, and it leaves the `.changeset/config.json` fixed group, the root `CONTRIBUTING.md` package table, two gate fixture lists and the lockfile (regenerated with `pnpm install --lockfile-only`, deletions only).
- **One gate floor moves:** `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts` counts the decidable links in every package README, and the retired README carried 2 of them (127 on the merge base, 125 here), so its floor moves from 126 to 125 with the measurement in its comment, as the `@object-ui/plugin-ai` retirement did. The site-absolute floor is unchanged (48 measured, floor 39).
- **One PR, no re-export shim**, as the seat ruled. Two changesets: `25921-providers-upload-fold.md` (fields and data-objectstack, patch, `!`, BREAKING paragraph, one FROM line naming the package, ADR-0087 marker `runtime-export-retired @object-ui/providers#*`) and `25921-upload-adapter-contract.md` (types, patch, widening).

**Changed lines: 2482 on the PR (+350 / −2132, 63 files; GitHub reads the two moved files as renames), under the 3000-line threshold** (seat correction; AGENTS.md reads the PR's `additions + deletions`). `dispatch-gates` counts with `--no-renames`, so it counts the moved code once as deleted and once as added and arrives at about 3,200 lines. 2386 of the deletions are the retired package's own nine files (its `CHANGELOG.md` alone is 1524).

## Why

The package existed so the widgets and the console could share one upload context. With the theme, data-source and metadata providers retired earlier (objectui#13453), every remaining export belonged to either the widgets or the ObjectStack data adapter.

## Tests

Behaviour is not changed, so the existing tests are the proof; they were re-pointed, not rewritten. All runs on `4e1e0e0e` (the scripts/ run first on `15c54522`, see Verification), under the shared verify lock:

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/ packages/data-objectstack/ packages/types/ packages/cli/src/__tests__/workspace-vite.test.ts`: 801 files passed, 1 skipped; 16261 tests passed, 7 skipped. This includes the moved objectui#12055 presign-body test and its compile-time pins.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console test` (the whole console project, since `App.tsx` changed): 298 files, 2939 tests passed, including `App.uploadAltitude-10131`, the three `FormPage` upload tests and the five `ProfilePage` tests.
- app-shell and plugin-form upload sites (every `views/__tests__/` file, the `ActionParamDialog`, `RecordDetailView`, settings and chatbot files that render an upload site, plus `WizardForm.nextMidUpload`, `affordanceGrantMap-12082`, `uploadInFlightSave`): 104 files, 937 tests passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: on `15c54522` 169 files passed and 1 failed, the doc-links floor above (expected 125 to be at least 126). With the floor moved, `check-doc-links.test.ts` alone passes 123/123; the full rerun on the final head is in the report.

No ablation: nothing tested changed behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- Behaviour is unchanged: `UploadProvider`, `useUpload` and `createObjectStackUploadAdapter` keep their signatures and bodies, and the presign request body is pinned by the moved objectui#12055 test.
- The plugin-form `WizardForm.nextMidUpload` test used to mock the `@object-ui/providers` module. A mock of the `@object-ui/fields` barrel would not reach the widgets, which import `./UploadProvider.js` relatively, so the test now mounts the real `UploadProvider` with a deferred adapter. It drives the same pending upload.
- Mentions of `@object-ui/providers` this PR leaves alone, because they are outside its file surface or are historical text that stays true:
  - `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md:249` and `:307` (governed; they still tell a reader to install `@object-ui/providers` for uploads, a follow-up).
  - `ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md:409` (governed).
  - `content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx:374` (release text).
  - The retired package's README held the `UploadProvider` usage guide. It now lives in `ui/packages/fields/README.md` (an `UploadProvider` section) and `ui/packages/data-objectstack/README.md` (a File Uploads section), added in the patch round (seat correction).
  - Historical comments that stay accurate: `ui/packages/types/src/theme.ts:68,77`, `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/p2-spec-exports.test.ts:256`, `ui/scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts:616`, the objectui#4194 error text quoted in `ui/packages/plugin-editor/vite.config.ts:64` and `ui/packages/plugin-markdown/vite.config.ts:64`, and `ui/.changeset/13453-*`, `13464-*`, `13465-*`, `25685-*` (not read by the root changeset config).

## Verification

- Build: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console... --filter='./packages/**' --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'`, 113/113 tasks, exit 0 (console `tsc` and `vite build` included).
- Type-check, each exit 0: `@object-ui/types`, `fields`, `data-objectstack`, `app-shell`, `plugin-form`, `console`, `cli`, `plugin-editor`, `plugin-markdown`, `runner` (`pnpm --filter PKG run type-check`, which compiles each package's tests where it has a test tsconfig).
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 60 commands, all run. 59 exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exited 1 on `15c54522` for the doc-links floor above, and its rerun on the final head is in the report. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` verifies `@object-ui/providers#*` (package deleted, absent from the workspace and the fixed group). `check:type-check-debt` exit 0 on the final head.
- Outside the derived list: `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols` exit 0; `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (0 anchored files); eslint on the 45 changed ui source files, 0 errors (the one react-compiler ref warning in `UploadProvider.tsx` is the same warning the original file carried).
- hotcrm census: shallow clone of `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at `6961ab1`, 0 hits for `@object-ui/providers`, `UploadProvider`, `useUpload`, `createObjectStackUploadAdapter`, `createS3Adapter`, `createAzureBlobAdapter`, `createObjectUrlAdapter`, with a control name hitting.
- The full dogfood battery (the title carries `!`) runs on the final head under the lock; its count goes in the dev report on #25921.
- `origin/main` has moved 5 commits since the base; `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` exits 0, and the one shared file (`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) is changed in a different region.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` untouched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on every changed ui source file: 0 errors.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched, nothing to regenerate.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. (The retired package's `CHANGELOG.md` is deleted with it, not edited.)
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The body carries the Chinese maintainer summary the dispatch rules require; everything else is English.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
